title: A lane reports only its own PR's ship verdict
body:
Source: lead 2026-11-16: the t-gt33vxe lane reported "PR #1183 merged 5858a69" (another lane's PR) as its own ship verdict; its ship log mentioned the standards-own-index worktree, so two lanes wrote and read one shared log path. Its own PR #1186 was open without auto-merge at that moment.
Outcome: a lane's ship verdict is read from a log path unique to its worktree (or straight from `krn pr ship` stdout), and the lane's final report names the PR number its own branch carries; `lanes.md` says so and a check refuses a lane report whose PR head branch is not the lane's branch.
Why: a false merged verdict hides an unshipped PR; the lead only caught it by reading origin/main.
Proof: a test feeds the report check a verdict naming a PR whose headRefName differs from the lane branch and gets a refusal.
